description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting a basic Island.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the basic Island.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return  Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
